name: advanced-tasks-supervisor
description: Advanced Tasks Supervisor — multi-tenant task management for workshops & factories (Next.js web + Node API + MongoDB)

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @ats/api --workspace @ats/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspace @ats/shared --workspace @ats/i18n --workspace @ats/api --workspace @ats/web
scripts.check:ci: npm run i18n:audit && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
